name: Marjorie Margolies
summary:
Marjorie Sue Margolies ( mar-GOH-leez; formerly Margolies-Mezvinsky; born June 21, 1942) is a former journalist and a Democratic politician. From 1993 to 1995, she was a member of the U.S. House of Representatives, representing Pennsylvania's 13th congressional district.
Margolies cast the deciding vote in favor of President Bill Clinton's 1993 budget proposal.
